retirement.reason: a pension is locked until you can start drawing it

checklist.name: Bank accounts
checklist.ask: Do you have money in a bank or savings account?
checklist.amount: Roughly how much, across all of them?

checklist.name: Pensions
checklist.ask: Do you have a workplace or personal pension?
checklist.amount: Roughly how much, all of them together?
checklist.hint: Your provider’s app or annual statement shows the value.

checklist.name: Investments
checklist.ask: Any investments — an ISA, funds, shares, an investing app?
checklist.amount: Roughly what are they worth today?

checklist.name: Home
checklist.ask: Do you own the home you live in?
checklist.amount: Roughly what would it sell for?

checklist.name: Mortgage
checklist.ask: Is there a mortgage on it?
checklist.amount: Roughly how much is left to pay?
checklist.hint: Your latest mortgage statement shows what’s outstanding.

checklist.name: Car
checklist.amount: Roughly what would it sell for?

checklist.name: Car finance
checklist.amount: Roughly how much is left to pay?

checklist.name: Other loans
checklist.ask: Anything else you owe — a student loan, a personal loan or a credit card?
